trap.label: colocação
trap.wrong: I have a say about the plan.
trap.right: I have a say in the plan.
trap.why: Português “opinar sobre”. Em inglês have a say in; have an effect on; have to + base.

mcq.q: Everyone should have a say **___** the decision.

fix.wrong: The rule has an effect in sales.
fix.right: The rule has an effect on sales.

fix.wrong: Workers have a say of the schedule.
fix.right: Workers have a say in the schedule.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “The rule has an effect on sales.”
rewrite.answer: The rule doesn’t have an effect on sales.
